title: An attacker who gains the ability to execute arbitrary code on a system with TrueConf Server (Linux) versions from…
description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in TrueConf Server (Linux) versions from 4.7.2 up to, but not including, 5.5.6. An attacker who can execute arbitrary code as the user 'trueconf' by exploiting another vulnerability can elevate their privileges to root.
